heading: INT. TOLL BOOTH UNDER THE TROLL BRIDGE - DAWN

units.text: INT. TOLL BOOTH UNDER THE TROLL BRIDGE - DAWN
A stone hut slung beneath a humped bridge.
Moss.
A river chuckles below.
A hand-lettered sign: PAY OR PASS (DON'T PASS).
BRAMBLE, 100, a troll in a postman's cap, sits behind a counter sorting copper coins.
Her skin is the color of a wet slate, her fingers like roots.
A herd of goats shuffles at her feet.
Morning, you lot. Don't touch the ledger.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: A shadow falls across the booth window.
ISKANDAR, 30s, a merchant in a long green coat, stands with a donkey cart.
He bows.
Good morning, tollkeeper.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: Toll's two coppers.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: That's very reasonable.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: It's the rate.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: Here is four, to be generous.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: Bramble takes the coins.
She bites one.
She looks at him with narrowed, amber eyes.
Nobody pays four.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: What was that?
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: Nothing. Weather. Cross.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: He nods, relieved, and starts the cart.
She lets him get three steps before she raises her voice.
Everyone, we have a customer who pays double!
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: The goats lift their heads as one.
Is something the matter?
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: No, no. Only that the last man who paid double was a king in disguise.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: I'm not a king.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: Of course not. Kings never are.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: She comes out from behind the counter.
She is much taller than the booth suggested.
The goats back away from her.
I think I'll pay for the road in kind.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: You'll pay the first thing you meet on the far side.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: That's an old story.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: It's an old toll.
units.name: BRAMBLE

units.text: From the far end of the bridge, a bell rings.
A small figure in a red coat is running toward the cart, arms wide, calling.
Leila.
units.name: ISKANDAR

units.text: Bramble watches him.
Her face does not change.
Always the child.
units.name: BRAMBLE
